title: Euclidean divergence theorem for a C¹ field on an open set vanishing off a compact subset
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) carry Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (= volume), let V ⊆ ℝⁿ be open and Q ⊆ V compact. Let w : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be of class C¹ on V with w(x) = 0 for every x ∈ V ∖ Q. Then ∫_V trace Dw(x) dLⁿ(x) = 0, where trace Dw(x) is the trace of the linear map Dw(x) = fderiv ℝ w x : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V Q : Set (Rn n)) (w : Rn n → Rn n), IsOpen V → IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w V → (∀ x ∈ V, x ∉ Q → w x = 0) → ∫ x in V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ w x).toLinearMap = 0
